title: Keep API route handlers thin
content: Route handlers should parse inputs, delegate to services, and format responses. Avoid embedding business rules or persistence logic directly in the route.

title: Validate inputs before DB operations
content: Perform presence, type, and business-shape validation before any repository or database operation so malformed requests fail fast.

title: Use structured logging on failures
content: When exceptions happen, log structured context like request id, user id, and operation name instead of raw print statements.

title: Separate controller, service, and repository responsibilities
content: Business rules belong in services, data access belongs in repositories, and transport-layer code should stay focused on request and response handling.
